active.title: REGARD — Robust evaluation of generative AI
active.partners: France–Canada programme · Academic partners and Orange Labs
active.description: REGARD studies evaluation of generative AI in real-world environments. It connects statistical questions about evaluation and uncertainty with realistic interaction settings. Within my research programme, it provides a setting for developing evaluation methods that account for limited evidence and imperfect feedback.

active.title: Learning and communication in attention-based models
active.description: This programme studies mathematical principles of learning and communication in attention-based models. It connects questions about task-relevant information and representations with the structure of modern learning systems. The aim is to develop mathematical characterisations that inform methods and experimentally testable predictions.

active.title: MolRGen — Molecular generation with reasoning models
active.description: This work develops a training and evaluation setting for de novo molecular generation with reasoning models. It connects modern language-model methods with molecular discovery, treating evaluation as an essential part of assessing scientific usefulness. Mistral AI supports the project through computing resources.

active.title: Foundation models for 3D medical imaging
active.description: This collaboration studies foundation models for 3D medical imaging and segmentation. Medical imaging provides a concrete setting for examining representations, generalisation and reliable predictions. The research programme connects model development with evaluation on domain-specific imaging tasks.

active.title: Foundation models for tabular data
active.description: This project studies foundation models for tabular data. It provides an application setting for investigating representations, transfer and evaluation across heterogeneous datasets. The objective is to connect reusable learning methods with the requirements of practical data analysis.

active.title: AI methods for aircraft flight assistance
active.description: This collaboration investigates AI methods for aircraft flight assistance. It connects learning and decision support in an engineering setting where partial information and reliability have concrete consequences. Research objectives include methods and evaluation conditions appropriate to assistance and control tasks.

active.title: Generative AI and information retrieval
active.description: This collaboration studies generative AI for industrial applications, including information retrieval. Work on pragmatic retrieval connects communication models with the problem of finding useful information. The project provides an operational context for research on representations, retrieval and language-based systems.

active.title: Cognitive communication for collaborative agents
active.partners: IVADO R2 · McGill · ÉTS · Université Laval
active.description: The programme studies cognitive communication for multi-agent reinforcement learning. It connects distributed information and communication with cooperative decisions, supporting research on when agents should communicate and how the value of that communication should be assessed.

completed.title: Safety AI within AIDA
completed.partners: Université Paris-Saclay · IBM France · BPI France
completed.description: Research on safety and reliability within a broader programme on AI and digital automation.

completed.title: Leakage of sensitive training data
completed.description: Research on information leakage from learned models, linking privacy attacks with information-theoretic analysis and experimental evaluation.

completed.title: Distributed representations and deep learning
completed.description: Information-theoretic principles for distributed representations and deep learning, connecting mathematical foundations with learning methods.
